description: This file defines the ModuleService class within the OrangeHRM project, providing methods for managing module data via a DAO pattern. It includes methods for retrieving and updating module information.

classes.name: ModuleService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing modules in the OrangeHRM system, acting as an intermediary between controllers and data access objects.

methods.name: getModuleDao
methods.description: Retrieves the current ModuleDao instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setModuleDao
methods.description: Sets the ModuleDao instance to be used by the service.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Returns a list of Module entities from the database.

methods.name: updateModuleStatus
methods.description: Updates the enabled/disabled status of modules based on the provided array.
